title: It’s a wonderful game!
body: I’m realy impressed. We can genuinely improve our lives by turning them into a game. However, there is one catch: the game gets boring quickly, and I gave up on it after a couple of months. It would be cool to have monsters and bosses in the game where weapons, armor, pets, upgradable skills, and so on could actually come in handy. Please consider my suggestion. Thanks!
author: Navi-gate

title: Great app! But..
body:
Would be awesome if it was possible to receive specific reminders for specific dailies, habits and to dos on your lock screen eg feed the cat at 9, go for a jog at 7 etc. 

Also would be nice to have repeat function for todos like each yeah or month  so that it was possible to put in the event that repeats not that often like birthdays 

Otherwise the app is amazing ! Keep it up!👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼
